properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

resourceType.Description: The type of resource the scheduled action is targeting

actionType.Description: The action the scheduled action should perform in the resources

startTime.Description: The time which the scheduled action is supposed to start running

endTime.Description: The time when the scheduled action is supposed to stop scheduling

schedule.Description: The schedule the scheduled action is supposed to follow

notificationSettings.Description: The notification settings for the scheduled action

disabled.Description: Tell if the scheduled action is disabled or not

provisioningState.Description: The status of the last provisioning operation performed on the resource.

scheduledTime.Description: The time the scheduled action is supposed to run on

timeZone.Description: The timezone the scheduled time is specified on

requestedWeekDays.Description: The week days the scheduled action is supposed to run on

requestedMonths.Description: The months the scheduled action is supposed to run on

requestedDaysOfTheMonth.Description: The days of the month the scheduled action is supposed to run on. If empty, it means it will run on every day of the month.

executionParameters.Description: The execution parameters the scheduled action is supposed to follow

deadlineType.Description: The type of deadline the scheduled action is supposed to follow for the schedule. If no value is passed, it will default to InitiateAt.

optimizationPreference.Description: Details that could optimize the user's request

retryPolicy.Description: Retry policy the user can pass

retryWindowInMinutes.Description: Retry window in minutes for user request

destination.Description: Where the notification should be sent. For email, it should follow email format.

type.Description: Type of notification to be sent.

language.Description: The language the notification should be sent on.

disabled.Description: Tells if the notification is enabled or not.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)

resultSummary.Description: The result for occurrences that achieved a terminal state

statuses.Description: The summarized status of the resources.

count.Description: The number of resources that the code applies to.

errorDetails.Description: The error details for the resources. Not populated on success cases.

message.Description: A human-readable representation of the error.
